admission.justification: Executable unit tests in tests/unit/test_file_size_gate.py pin each band boundary and the different exit statuses for watchful and over-limit files.

applicability: Line-count classification and hard-rail exit status for readable Python files measured by src/rh_pipeline/validate/file_size.py (registered as rh-file-size-gate and invoked by scripts/check-quality.sh).
conditions: With default limits, the inclusive band ceilings are 300 (healthy), 600 (watchful), 900 (refactor-pressure) and 1200 (soft-limit-exceeded) lines; watchful reporting starts at 301 lines and only files above hard_limit (default 1200) trigger exit code 1.
The CLI defaults to scanning src and tests in sorted order. With an explicit --hard-limit, the hard rail follows that limit.
exclusions: Tool invocation and source-read errors are outside the size-based exit rule.
statement: The file-size gate classifies Python files into five ordered bands, reports watchful files starting at 301 lines and fails only when a file exceeds the hard limit.
title: Five-band Python file-size gate and hard limit
